alerts.headline: From 9 p.m. Monday, Oct. 5, until 6 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 6, two lanes of southbound I-405 will close between Northeast 68th and 12th streets for crack sealing and pavement repair. Delays are possible through the work zone.

From 9 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 6, to 5 a.m. Wednesday, Oct. 7, the right lane of eastbound SR 520 will close between I-405 and Northeast 40th Street for pavement repair. Delays are possible through the work zone.
From 9 to 11:30 p.m. on Tuesday night, Oct. 6, the northbound I-405 on-ramp to eastbound SR 520 will close for pavement repair. Signed detours will guide people around the closure.
From 9 p.m. Wednesday, Sept. 30, to 5 a.m. Thursday, Oct. 1, the eastbound I-90 on-ramp from 142nd Place Southeast will close for construction. Signed detours will be available.

From 8 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 8 to 5 a.m. Friday, Oct. 9, expect flaggers at the northbound Interstate 405 off-ramp to Southeast 8th Street near the Old Wilburton Tunnel (milepost 12) for utilities work.
From 11:59 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 6, until 1:30 a.m. Wednesday, Oct. 7, the eastbound SR 520 off-ramp to 124th Avenue Northeast will close for pavement repairs. Signed detours will be available.
The northbound and southbound SR 527 on-ramps to southbound I-405 will be closed from 10 p.m. Friday, Oct. 9 to 4 a.m. Monday, Oct. 12.
The Northeast 195th Street on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed from 10 p.m. Friday, Oct. 9 to 4 a.m. Monday, Oct. 12.
The southbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 195th Street will be closed from 10 p.m. Friday, Oct. 9 to 4 a.m. Monday, Oct. 12.
All lanes of southbound I-405 between SR 527 (milepost 26.35) and SR 522 (milepost 23.47) will be closed from 10 p.m. Friday, Oct. 9 to 4 a.m. Monday, Oct. 12
From 8 a.m. Monday, Oct. 12 to noon Friday, Oct. 16, the northbound Interstate 5 SeaTac rest area will close for maintenance.

Westbound I-90 is reduced to three lanes near the 17th Street Northwest on-ramp to the Lakemont Boulevard off-ramp, with traffic shifts to accommodate construction. The HOV lane is open to all drivers.
The southbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 85th Street will be fully closed day and night from 10 p.m. Friday, Oct. 2 – 5 a.m. Monday, Oct. 5.
The northbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 85th Street will be fully closed day and night, from 10 p.m. Friday, Oct. 2 – 5 a.m. Monday, Oct. 5.
The Northeast 85th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be fully closed day and night, from 10 p.m. Friday, Oct. 2 – 5 a.m. Monday, Oct. 5.
Up to three lanes of northbound I-405 between milepost 17.45 and milepost 18.12 will be closed overnight from 11 p.m. Saturday, Oct. 3 to 8:30 a.m. Sunday, Oct. 4.

The right lane on northbound and southbound SR 161 will close during the day Sunday through Thursday for about six weeks for ongoing fish passage construction. 

From 6 a.m. to 3 p.m., one lane of southbound SR 161 will close.

From 9 p.m. to 5 p.m., one lane of northbound SR 161 will close.

People traveling through the area during these times should expect delays, particularly during peak travel times.

Until further notice, SR 161 is reduced to one lane in each direction between 36th Street East and Dechaux Road East on North Hill due to slide activity. Travelers can expect shifted lanes and congestion approaching North Hill.
From 2 to 5 a.m. on Wednesday, Oct. 7, the eastbound SR 520 on- and off-ramps at 148th Avenue Northeast will close for pavement repairs. Signed detours will be available.
From 2 to 5 a.m. on Wednesday, Oct. 7, the eastbound SR 520 on- and off-ramps at Northeast 40th Street will close for pavement repairs. Signed detours will guide people around the closure.
From 11:59 p.m. Monday, Sept. 28, to 4 am. Tuesday, Sept. 29, the northbound I-405 off-ramp to northbound SR 167 will close for crack sealing and pavement repair. Signed detours will be available.

The Sunset Boulevard Northeast on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed overnight from 9 p.m. – 8 a.m., starting the night of Saturday, Oct. 3 to the morning of Sunday, Oct. 4. A signed detour will be in place.
The express lanes are closed 24 hours a day until 5 a.m. Monday, Oct. 5, for drainage work on the Ship Canal Bridge.

From 5 to 11:30 a.m. Saturday, Oct. 3, two right lanes of the southbound SR 99 Aurora Avenue Bridge (milepost 34) will close for maintenance. From 5 to 11:30 a.m. Sunday, Oct. 4, two right lanes of the northbound SR 99 Aurora Avenue Bridge will close.
From 1 to 3 a.m. nightly on Wednesday, Oct. 7, and Thursday, Oct. 8, one lane of Northeast 145th Street/SR 523 will close for pavement repair. At least one lane will remain open.
The Harvard Avenue on-ramp to northbound I-5 is closed until mid-October for the Revive I-5 Ship Canal Bridge construction project.

From 9 p.m. Friday, Oct. 2 to 5 a.m. Saturday, Oct. 3, the eastbound South Spokane Street/West Seattle Freeway viaduct to eastbound South Columbian Way will close for maintenance. This work may also need to occur the night of Saturday, Oct. 3.
From 1 to 1:30 a.m. on Tuesday, Oct. 6, two lanes of southbound I-5 will close between Northeast 45th and 80th streets for pavement repair. Delays are possible during this short-duration closure.
From 9 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 8, to 5 a.m. Friday, Oct. 9, up to two lanes of Northeast 145th Street/SR 523 will close near the I-5 interchange for pavement repair. Signed detours will be available.

Friday, Oct. 2, until the morning of Monday, Oct. 5 - Eastbound SR 520 between I-5 and Montlake Boulevard in Seattle will close for construction beginning at 11 p.m. on Oct. 2 until 5 a.m. on Oct. 5. All traffic from I-5 wanting to access eastbound SR 520 must use alternate routes. Eastbound SR 520 remains open across Lake Washington. It is only the section of eastbound SR 520 between I-5 and Montlake that will close. The Montlake Boulevard on-ramp to eastbound SR 520 will remain open.
From 3 to 4:30 a.m. on Tuesday, Oct. 6, three lanes of southbound I-5 will close between SR 104 and Northeast 175th Street for pavement repair. Delays are possible through the work zone.
From 3 to 4:30 a.m. on Tuesday, Oct. 6, the Northeast 175th Street on-ramp to southbound I-5 will close for pavement repairs. Signed detours will be available.
From 3 to 4:30 a.m. on Tuesday, Oct. 6, the southbound I-5 on-ramp from King County Metro North Bus Base will close for pavement repair. Signed detours will be available.

Daily from 7 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. beginning Tuesday, Oct. 13 to 2:30 p.m. Wednesday, Oct. 14, US 2 traffic will alternate with flaggers at Sky Lane (milepost 49) for maintenance. This work may also need to occur on Tuesday, Oct. 20 and Wednesday, Oct. 21.
From 6 a.m. to 2 p.m. daily Monday, Oct. 5, through Friday afternoon, Oct. 9, the left lane of eastbound I-90 will close near the SR 18 interchange in Snoqualmie. Expect delays in the area.

From 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Monday, Oct. 5, through Thursday afternoon, Oct. 8, the left lane on westbound I-90 will close near the SR 18 interchange in Snoqualmie for construction. Expect delays through the work zone.

Daily from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m. beginning Tuesday, Oct. 13 to 1 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 15, one left lane of northbound State Route 599 from Interstate 5 to South 133rd Street (milepost 0) will close for maintenance.

Up to two lanes of southbound I-405 from SR 181 (milepost 1) to I-5 (milepost 0) will be closed overnight and during the day, 7 p.m. – 1 p.m., starting the night of Saturday, Oct. 3 to the afternoon of Sunday, Oct. 4.

The southbound I-405 HOV off-ramp to northbound I-5 will be closed overnight and during the day, 7 p.m. – 1 p.m., starting the night of Saturday, Oct. 3 to the afternoon of Sunday, Oct. 4. Signed detours will be in place.
From 7 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 6 to 10 a.m. Wednesday, Oct. 7, State Route 104 will close in both directions at Main Street and Railroad Avenue (milepost 24) for BNSF railroad work.

Beginning Sept. 24, 2021 until further notice: The southbound Interstate 5 Silver Lake Rest Area is closed for maintenance indefinitely. There is no access for recreational vehicle dumping at this location.

From 10 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 13 to 4 a.m. Wednesday, Oct. 14, the left lane of northbound Interstate 5 from the Ebey Slough Bridge to 88th Street Northeast (milepost 200) will close for maintenance work.
From 8 p.m. Sunday, Oct. 11 to 5 a.m. Monday, Oct. 12, State Route 96 traffic at 51st Avenue Southeast (milepost 3) will alternate with flaggers for utilities work.

From 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings crews will alternate traffic with flaggers and pilot cars in sections between a nearly 11-mile stretch of SR 203, just south of Duvall to the Monroe city limits (mileposts 12.53 to 23.20).

Beginning Monday, Sept. 21 until 5 a.m. Friday, Oct. 9: Nightly from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. (except Saturdays), State Route 203 traffic will alternate with flaggers from US 2 to Main Street (milepost 24) for utilities.

Nightly, from 9 p.m. until 7 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings, contractor crews will alternate traffic through the intersections of State Route 525 in Mukilteo between Paine Field and the Mukilteo Ferry Terminal for pedestrian upgrades. Pedestrians may need to use local roads to detour around the work zone.
Lowell-Snohomish River Road will alternate traffic near SR 9 beginning Wednesday, Sept. 30.
From 9 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 8 to 2 a.m. Friday, Oct. 9, US 2 traffic will alternate with flaggers at Fern Bluff Road (milepost 20) for utilities work.
